headline: S266 restored a blank membership calculator and made missing browser runtimes a blocking class.

items.title: Membership value calculator runtime restored
items.insight: The value page now loads the runtime for the calculator it already mounted. Visitors get the personalized tier recommendation instead of an empty framed feature.
items.evidence: membership-value/index.html; browser proof at 390px returned $43, 23 options, Recommended: VaultSparked

items.title: Calculator mount requires its runtime
items.insight: A missing feature runtime now fails in the page-script gate. The self-test covers both the working mount and the blank-card regression.
items.evidence: scripts/check-page-script-relevance.mjs; self-test 9/9; live scan 167 pages clean

items.title: Browser asset orphans are blocking
items.insight: The orphan baseline is clean, so browser-shipped JavaScript can now be guarded strictly. Manual scripts stay advisory, but public feature runtimes can no longer disappear quietly.
items.evidence: package.json; node scripts/check-orphan-assets.mjs --strict; npm run build:check step 41

items.title: Task board stale blocks rotated
items.insight: The live task board shed two stale session blocks without deleting history. Future startup reads stay leaner while the archive keeps the full trail.

followUps: Run post-push CI/deploy confirmation for the S266 tip.
Use fresh trace/waterfall evidence before editing homepage field LCP.
Handle Football GM INP through the owning repo or Ark after a fresh soak window.

honestyLedger.title: Field performance not force-closed
honestyLedger.why: Build-check still reports homepage field LCP and Football GM INP over budget. This session recorded those as evidence-backed carries instead of claiming an unrelated fix.
